block_description: Interactive fill-in-the-blanks and audio dictation exercise with Bootstrap 5 and Vanilla JS.
default_instruction: Fill in the blank spaces with the correct answers.
inspector_case_sensitive_help: If enabled, 'Blue' and 'blue' will be considered different.
inspector_accept_typos_help: Accepts words with 1 character difference (Levenshtein distance).
inspector_ignore_accents_help: If enabled, accents and diacritics will not affect correctness.
inspector_audio_help: Add an MP3 audio file to turn this exercise into a dictation activity.
inspector_show_word_bank_help: Displays the available words shuffled to help students.
editor_raw_text_placeholder: Type your text using *word* for simple blanks or *[option1|option2]* for multiple alternatives...
editor_syntax_tip: Syntax tip: Use *blue* for single answer or *[blue|cyan]* for multiple acceptable options.
editor_no_gaps: No blanks detected. Wrap words with asterisks, e.g. *answer*.
feedback_perfect: Excellent! You got all {total} blanks right! Score: 100%
feedback_partial: You got {correct} out of {total} blanks correct ({percent}%).
feedback_exhausted: Attempts exhausted! Check the correct answers below.
feedback_fill_all: Please fill in all blanks before checking.
